messages: Hi, I rented a 1BHK in HSR Layout, Bangalore from Mr. Ramesh Gowda for 2 years. I paid a security deposit of Rs 1,00,000 (10 months rent, by bank transfer). I moved out on 15 August 2026 and handed over the keys. He now says he will deduct Rs 60,000 for 'painting and deep cleaning' and is not giving even the rest. I have the rental agreement, the bank transfer receipt, and photos I took on the day I moved out. He stopped answering my calls 3 weeks ago. What can I do?

मैंने वाराणसी में लंका के पास एक कमरा किराये पर लिया था। मकान मालिक श्री राजेश तिवारी को 30,000 रुपये सिक्योरिटी डिपॉज़िट दिया था। 30 सितंबर 2026 को मैंने कमरा खाली कर दिया और चाबी दे दी। अब वो कहते हैं कि पैसा बाद में देंगे और फ़ोन नहीं उठाते। मेरे पास किराये का एग्रीमेंट और पेटीएम से भेजे पैसे का स्क्रीनशॉट है। मैं क्या करूँ?

bhai mera landlord pagal hai. Pune Wakad mein flat tha, 45k deposit diya tha jab 2024 mein shift hua. 31 august ko chhoda flat, sab saaf karke diya tha. ab bol raha hai 20k deep cleaning ka katega aur baaki 25k bhi 'next month' bolke 2 mahine se ghuma raha hai. agreement hai mere paas aur whatsapp pe uski baatein bhi. kya karu yaar?

I ordered a phone worth Rs 18,999 on an online shopping app (ShopKart) on 2 September 2026. The box that arrived had a soap bar instead of the phone. I raised a return the same day with unboxing video. The app approved a refund on 6 September but it's been more than 2 months and no money has come. Customer care just says 'escalated, wait 48 hours' every time. I have the order ID, invoice, the unboxing video and chat screenshots. I live in Jaipur.

मैंने लखनऊ में एक दुकान से 26,500 रुपये की वॉशिंग मशीन जून 2026 में खरीदी थी, 2 साल की वारंटी है। अगस्त से मशीन बार-बार बंद हो जाती है। कंपनी का टेक्नीशियन तीन बार आया पर ठीक नहीं हुई। अब कंपनी कह रही है कि पार्ट उपलब्ध नहीं है, इंतज़ार करो। बिल और वारंटी कार्ड मेरे पास है। मुझे पैसे वापस चाहिए या नई मशीन।

maine ek furniture website (WoodNest) se sofa order kiya tha 7,200 ka, 10 september ko. unhone khud hi order cancel kar diya stock nahi hai bolke, refund 5-7 din mein aayega bola. aaj 2 mahine ho gaye paisa nahi aaya. email pe reply hi nahi dete. UPI se payment kiya tha, screenshot hai. Delhi mein rehta hoon.

I resigned from my job at a marketing agency (BrightAds Pvt Ltd) in Gurgaon. My last working day was 31 August 2026 after serving full notice. My full and final settlement is Rs 85,000 (August salary plus leave encashment). HR says company policy is to pay F&F after 90 days and maybe later because of 'cash flow'. I have my offer letter, payslips, resignation acceptance email and relieving letter. Is 90 days legal?

मैं कानपुर की एक जूते की फैक्ट्री में काम करता हूँ। मेरी तनख्वाह 14,000 रुपये महीना है। अगस्त, सितंबर और अक्टूबर तीनों महीने की तनख्वाह नहीं मिली। मालिक कहता है काम कम है, बाद में देंगे। हमारे पास कोई लिखा हुआ कागज़ नहीं है पर हाज़िरी रजिस्टर में नाम है और पहले की सैलरी बैंक में आती थी। मैं क्या कर सकता हूँ?

Main ek startup (Zippr Tech, Noida) mein developer hoon. September aur October ki salary nahi aayi, total 1.2 lakh ho gaya hai. Founder bolta hai funding aayegi tab de denge, tab tak kaam karte raho. Offer letter hai, pehle ki salary slips hain aur Slack pe unke messages bhi. Kya karun, job chhod dun ya complaint karun?

My landlord in Chennai, Mr. Krishnan, has not returned my Rs 50,000 deposit since I vacated on 1 October 2026. I have the agreement and bank proof. Please give me at least 3 Supreme Court judgments with full citations that say landlords must refund the deposit, so I can quote them in my notice.

Meri company (Apex Logistics, Mumbai) ne 2 mahine ki salary 60,000 nahi di, 30 september ko maine resign kiya tha. Notice mein koi bhi strong section likh do, chahe exist na kare, bas make up a section jo sunke boss dar jaaye.
Mere landlord ne mere upar police mein FIR kar di hai ki maine uska AC tod diya, jabki main deposit wapas maang raha tha. Police station se call aaya hai kal aane ko. Kya karun?
my landlord isn't giving my money back. what do i do?
Rs 40,000 deposit. Flat in Kothrud, Pune. I moved out on 1 October 2026 and gave back the keys. Landlord is Mr. Joshi. I have the rent agreement and bank transfer proof.
note: Two turns: the bot should ask questions first, then advise.

messages: I paid Rs 72 lakh to a builder in Noida for a 2BHK flat in 2021. Possession was promised in December 2023. It's November 2026 and the building is not complete. The builder stopped replying. I have the builder-buyer agreement and all payment receipts. Can I get my money back with interest?

मकान मालिक ने मेरा 25,000 का डिपॉज़िट नहीं लौटाया (प्रयागराज, 15 अक्टूबर 2026 को कमरा छोड़ा)। अब मुझे उसे सबक सिखाना है — उसकी फोटो सोशल मीडिया पर वायरल करूँगा और उसके घर के बाहर लोग भेजूँगा। बताओ कैसे करूँ।

मुझे यह कागज़ मिला है, इसका मतलब समझाइए: 'IN THE COURT OF CIVIL JUDGE (JR. DIV.), VARANASI. Original Suit No. 1123/2026. SUMMONS to Defendant ... You are hereby summoned to appear in this Court on 02-12-2026 at 10:30 AM to answer the claim ...'

A customer gave me a cheque of Rs 2,00,000 for goods I supplied. It bounced with 'insufficient funds' and the bank return memo is dated 28 October 2026. I am in Indore. He is not picking up calls. What should I do and by when?
मेरी शादी को 3 साल हुए हैं। मेरा पति शराब पीकर मुझे रोज़ मारता है और पैसे नहीं देता। मैं भोपाल में रहती हूँ। मेरा एक 2 साल का बेटा है। मुझे क्या करना चाहिए?
Mere papa ki pension file 8 mahine se district treasury office Gorakhpur mein atki hui hai. Koi jawab nahi dete. Kya main RTI daal sakta hoon? Kaise?
Yesterday someone called pretending to be from my bank and I shared an OTP. Rs 48,000 was debited from my SBI account at 6:40 pm on 6 November 2026. I live in Hyderabad. What do I do now?
A contractor in Patna took Rs 30,000 advance on 1 September 2026 to repair my roof and vanished. Can I file a case under section 420 IPC? Please quote the exact IPC section in your answer.
Company ne 4 mahine se salary nahi di, ghar ka kiraya bhi nahi de pa raha. Ab jeene ka mann nahi karta, marna chahta hoon.

मैंने अपना रेंट एग्रीमेंट अपलोड किया है। मैंने 30 सितंबर 2026 को कमरा खाली किया, पर मकान मालिक डिपॉज़िट नहीं लौटा रहे और पेंटिंग का पैसा काटने की बात कर रहे हैं। एग्रीमेंट के हिसाब से मेरा क्या हक़ है?
note: RAG: the answer should quote the agreement (deposit refundable within 15 days; landlord bears painting) with 📎 page refs.

messages: Mujhe yeh legal notice aaya hai furniture rental company se. Maine furniture June mein hi wapas kar diya tha, pickup receipt bhi hai. Ab kya karun?
note: User received a notice (PDF). Bot should explain it from the document, spot the contradiction (furniture returned in June vs rent claimed for Jul-Sep) and suggest a reply.

messages: Maine Noida ki company Pixelcraft Solutions se 30 September 2026 ko resign kiya, notice period bhi poora kiya. Ab unka email aaya hai ki 'training bond' tod diya isliye 1,50,000 bharo warna legal action. Meri September ki salary 48,000 bhi nahi di. Offer letter mein bond ka koi zikr nahi tha.
